title: SAM3-UNet: Simplified Adaptation of Segment Anything Model 3
mechanism: SAM3 image encoder with a simple adapter and a light U-Net decoder; under 6 GB at batch 12.
adaptation: 1008 input (2x of 512), 3-ch replicated EL, 24-class head, house loss and schedule; run in parallel with SAM2-UNet and keep the better for ensembles.
min_experiment: SAM3-UNet vs house PF and vs SAM2-UNet; 5-fold CV then 3 seeds clean-49 + E1; same kill line as SAM2-UNet.
evidence: R (from CoRe-SAM3 Table 2): SAM3-UNet 68.6% mean crack IoU over 5 crack sets (84-2,357 train images) vs native SAM3 62.3%, crack specialists 67.8-70.0%.

alt_notes.adaptation: Same recipe as SAM2-UNet on the SAM3 encoder at 1008 px (2x upscale of 512); 24-class head; house loss and aug. Provides the SAM3 encoder arm.
alt_notes.min_experiment: SAM3-UNet @1008, 3 seeds vs house and vs SAM2-UNet; same metrics; kill as SAM2-UNet. Run only after weights licence OK.
